frozen.frozen_note: Pre-registration. Immutable after the P0 commit: the verifier compares this object with its copy at that commit. Moving a pillar away from a predicted IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED needs a falsification artifact in that pillar's evidence.

D-W7.weighting: input 1 + cache_read 0.1 + cache_write 2 (1h assumed; index does not split TTL) + output 5. ESTIMATE of relative token burden, not price, not the Owner's meter.
D-W7.caveat: index state as read 2026-10-03; later refreshes may add rows for this window, which is why the raw figures are frozen here

anchor.reproduced: 2026-10-03, exact match with CCP RESUMPTION s2

materiality.rule: a dedicated local slice needs >= 3 % of a named weighted denominator (default D-W7)
materiality.exceptions: correctness, authority, security, horizontal primitive: argued separately in the pillar's evidence; an exception never lowers the threshold for another pillar
materiality.displacement: a saving is realized only when displaced work is measured on the same denominator; otherwise it is an interval or UNKNOWN

pillars.name: baseline cognitive economics
pillars.rule: gate vault/programs/cognitive-economy/gates/gate_baseline.py: the CCP anchor reproduces exactly (23925 calls / 6230548450 cache read / 9893 subagent calls) and the D-W7 raw figures reproduce within 0.5 %; the after-snapshot is taken at the final phase with the same command and reported beside, never folded into, the before

pillars.name: resident context floor
pillars.rule: each rules->skills move needs an Owner y per move (CCP RESUMPTION s4); the campaign batches the remaining moves into P5 and never executes one

pillars.name: skill/agent/tool capability virtualization
pillars.rule: skills/agents consumed from their owners; tool schemas: build lazy loading only if MCP/tool schema residency >= 3 % of D-W7 weighted

pillars.name: context lifetime / dead context
pillars.rule: measure realized savings of the live economic trigger with rehydration displacement; hand result to owner; no edit of rollover.py or context-watchdog.py

pillars.name: fresh-epoch economics
pillars.rule: measure continuation vs rotation from tools/gsd_epoch.py census; propose to owner only if a threshold change is worth >= 3 % of D-W7

pillars.name: reread / materialized cognition
pillars.rule: sibling re-derivation is a lever only if identical-dependency re-reads across sibling subagents are >= 3 % of D-W7 weighted

pillars.name: common cognitive subexpression elimination
pillars.rule: reopened only if F finds recurrence with a valid identity boundary (same inputs, same dependency hashes)

pillars.name: turns per verified advancement
pillars.rule: deliver a reproducible turn taxonomy (advancing/coordination/bookkeeping/recovery/proof/repeat/non-convergent) over usage_index joined to git; any optimization it suggests faces the 3 % rule

pillars.name: one-shot work packet
pillars.rule: exists (epoch brief + Ralph card); no build

pillars.name: non-convergence detection
pillars.rule: decided from H: non-advancing turns of interactive roots >= 3 % of D-W7 earns a detector proposal; also record (audit G5) that Ralph no_progress fingerprints the whole work dir, so in a shared checkout peer churn reads as progress

pillars.name: tool output admission
pillars.rule: one replication on the CPP corpus with the same instrument; a firewall needs one class >= 3 % NOT_OBSERVED/IMMEDIATE carriage

pillars.name: capability compile-out
pillars.rule: compound steps 7+8 owned by a NEW campaign module (never tools/compound_unattended.py: foreign uncommitted diff; never hook-dispatcher.js: live global) with mutex, backup, atomic rename and rollback, proven by its own gate against a TEMP copy of the state and real learning files; applying it to the live global state and the call-site switch are Owner items, not part of this terminal (audit G6)

pillars.name: model / processor allocation
pillars.rule: CCP C4 owns model policy; any routing experiment spends quota and needs Owner

pillars.name: event-driven cognition
pillars.rule: zero-LLM scheduled sweeps exist; no build

pillars.name: cognitive IR / state normalization
pillars.rule: Goal spine stays the canonical durable-goal store (generated KSR view falsified); this campaign's authority is the committed ledger because the spine pins every verdict to the whole HEAD^{tree} when the scope is clean, so closure is unreachable in a shared checkout (audit G1-G4) -- that finding is handed to the spine's owner; no edit of modules/gsd_x/goal

pillars.name: proof reuse / incremental verification
pillars.rule: build only if verification (test/gate tool calls + their output carriage) >= 3 % of D-W7 weighted

pillars.name: technical capital accounting
pillars.rule: CAPEX/OPEX recorded per pillar in this ledger; no dashboard

pillars.name: institutionalization / UKDL
pillars.rule: UKDL 3-level (hard/process/trap) and CBR review written to the campaign-owned vault/programs/cognitive-economy/ukdl-candidates.md, each entry evidence-cited with a promote/reject/keep-candidate verdict and reason; promotion INTO ukdl-universal.md (peer-hot, audit G10) is an Owner item

pillars.name: universal baseline compiler
pillars.rule: audit trait->obligation derivation; extend only on a measured gap

pillars.name: institutional GC / simplification
pillars.rule: liveness sweep + retire proposals; settings.json and skill removal need Owner
